Zenodo record of the Florida Pasture Cube data

Source: R/download.R
fpc_record.Rd

The record identifier of the version 1.3 data set on Zenodo (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24542431). fpc_files() and fpc_download() use it by default.

Usage

fpc_record

Format

A character string.

Examples

fpc_record
#> [1] "24542431"
paste0("https://zenodo.org/records/", fpc_record)
#> [1] "https://zenodo.org/records/24542431"
